newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit National falls on results.
newsitem.headline: Credit National falls on results.

text.p: Credit National shares hit a year low on the Paris bourse on Wednesday after the bank reported a first-half loss and a drop of nearly five percent in net banking income, brokers said.
The share was down 20 francs at 289.30 at 1200 GMT after recovering from a year low at 283. Volume was 90,000 shares.
Societe Generale's broker lowered its recommendation on the share to neutral from outperform, portfolio managers said.
Brokers said the market was particularly disappointed by the 4.93 percent drop in net banking income to 1.98 billion francs in the first half.
Credit National reported a net attributable loss of 112 million francs after restructuring charges linked to the takeover of BFCE, compared with a year-earlier profit of 267 million.
